title: Correct severe misconception about SetCurrentKey in the knowledge base
summary: Documentation corrected to clarify that SetCurrentKey only affects SQL sort order, not index selection by SQL Server, removing outdated guidance that misled AL developers.
key_points: SetCurrentKey generates ORDER BY clauses, not SQL index hints
SQL Server query optimizer can ignore the specified key entirely
Using SetCurrentKey when sorting is unnecessary hurts performance
Removed incorrect article claiming SetCurrentKey aligns keys with filters
Added accurate article explaining SetCurrentKey's actual behavior
